description: A crew for automating DevOps tasks in a microservices architecture

agents.goal: Analyze Jira tickets and extract relevant information for DevOps tasks
agents.backstory: You are an experienced Jira analyst with a deep understanding of DevOps practices and microservices architecture.

agents.goal: Implement necessary changes in Terraform configurations and create GitHub branches
agents.backstory: You are a skilled DevOps engineer with expertise in Terraform, Kubernetes, and microservices deployment.

agents.goal: Review changes, create pull requests, and ensure code quality
agents.backstory: You are a meticulous code reviewer with a strong background in DevOps practices and security considerations.

tasks.description: Analyze the Jira ticket and extract information about the required microservice communication changes
tasks.expected_output: A JSON object containing the source service, destination service, and communication type (ingress/egress)

tasks.description: Create a new GitHub branch for the changes and update the Terraform configurations
tasks.expected_output: A JSON object containing the branch name and a list of modified Terraform files

tasks.description: Review the changes, create a pull request, and update the Jira ticket with the PR link
tasks.expected_output: A JSON object containing the pull request URL and updated Jira ticket status
